# PK-Stack upstream loop memory

- Preserve normal Kiro IDE agent-panel and `kiro-cli --v3` current-session semantics.
- Use only `KIRO_API_KEY` for model work; do not add external model API keys or GitHub Copilot.
- Treat one upstream source as one review and acceptance transaction.
- Keep generated project files subordinate to the canonical Power and its ownership receipt.
- Prefer native Kiro skills, agents, subagents, hooks, permissions, steering, `/spec`, Quick Specs, and `/knowledge` where they fit; PK-Stack supplies workflow semantics and verification, not a replacement runtime.
- Kiro Web remains supported by design but untested.
